tool_description:
Provides a model of the Pokemon Trading Card Game cards.
Each individual card has a price that is based on recent sales of the card or currently open listings.
name: Pokemon TCG Card Prices
title: Pokemon TCG Card Prices

api_list.name: Get Many Cards
api_list.description:
Returns many cards based on query parameters.

A card represents a single card that can be defined by a combination of series / set / number in set / variant.

optional_parameters.name: fromId
optional_parameters.description:
A paging parameter. The ID from which the query will continue.
Calls for many results include a fromId field that can be used as a query param in the next call to get the next page of results

api_list.name: Get One Card by Id
api_list.description: Gets details about a single card by it's ID.
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://pokemon-tcg-card-prices.p.rapidapi.com/card/c4cbb4b6-ceba-4b14-8e28-ad2b590ccd59"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "pokemon-tcg-card-prices.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

api_list.name: Get Many Sets
api_list.description:
Returns many sets based on query parameters.

A set is a grouping of cards that are periodically released together. Every card has a set. Every set is part of a series.
